claim: Berlin in June averages highs of 23.1°C (73.6°F) and lows near 13°C (55°F), with ~16h 45m of daylight (sunrise ~04:48, sunset ~21:19-21:32).
quote: average high-temperature of 23.1°C (73.6°F) and a low-temperature of 12.9°C (55.2°F)... June features the longest days of the year in Berlin, with an average of 16 hours and 42-45 minutes of daylight

claim: Late May daily highs in Berlin range 71-82°F (~22-28°C) with overnight lows 51-62°F and overcast/mostly cloudy ~50% of the time.
quote: Daily high temperatures range from 71° to 82°F, with overnight lows between 51° and 62°F... overcast or mostly cloudy conditions about 50% of the time

claim: Berlin WelcomeCard 48h costs €28.50 for zone AB (city) or €34.50 for ABC (incl. BER airport and Potsdam) and grants up to 50% off at 170+ partners.
quote: Zone AB (Berlin city): €28.50 regular rate; Zone ABC (Berlin plus surrounding area including Potsdam and BER Airport): €34.50 regular rate... Up to 50% discount at over 170 discount partners

claim: BVG single AB ticket is €4.00, short-trip €2.80, 24h AB ticket €11.20, 24h ABC €12.90, 24h group ticket (up to 5) €35.30 AB.
quote: Single Ticket: Fare zone AB: €4 (regular)... Short Trip Ticket: €2.80... 24-Hour Ticket: Fare zone AB: €11.20... 24-Hour Group Ticket (up to 5 people): Fare zone AB: €35.30

claim: FEX from BER runs every 15 min, 23 minutes to Hauptbahnhof; S9/S85 run every ~10 min, with S9 reaching Friedrichstraße in ~40 min; ABC single ticket €5.00 from Jan 2026.
quote: The FEX runs every 15 minutes from 04:00 am to 01:00 am... 23 minutes to Hauptbahnhof... S-Bahn lines S85 and S9 also stop at BER, reaching the airport approximately every 10 minutes... a single ABC ticket costing €4.70 (from January 1, 2026: €5.00) is required

claim: Karneval der Kulturen 2026 runs May 22-25 over Pentecost weekend, with the main parade Sunday May 24 starting 13:30 at Frankfurter Allee/Proskauer Straße, ending ~22:00.
quote: May 22 to May 25, 2026... The parade... will take place on May 24, 2026. It starts at 1:30 p.m. at the intersection of Frankfurter Allee, Proskauer Straße, and Niederbarnimstraße. The last group starts around 7 p.m., and the parade ends at 10 p.m.

claim: Fête de la Musique Berlin happens June 21, 2026 with ~300 free stages across all 12 districts; outdoor performances begin 16:00, indoor evening shows from 22:00.
quote: Berlin hosts performances all day across nearly 300 stages scattered throughout its 12 districts... The outdoor afternoon performances kick off at 4pm on June 21. Then, at 10pm the festival moves indoors

claim: Mitte is the recommended central first-visit base near Museum Island, TV Tower and Berliner Dom; Prenzlauer Berg is leafy and family-friendly.
quote: Mitte means "middle" and is Berlin's central district, making it the best neighborhood to stay in Berlin if it's your first time visiting... Prenzlauer Berg is considered one of the safest and most family-friendly neighbourhoods

claim: Friedrichshain mixes families and artists with techno temples like Berghain and Boxhagener Platz weekend markets, often cheaper than Mitte.
quote: Friedrichshain has mellowed in recent years, attracting more families and artists, while still featuring world-renown club temples like Berghain and Club Ost alongside weekend Boxhagener Platz markets

claim: Kreuzberg is Berlin's counterculture/nightlife district with street art, döner, spätis and the Landwehrkanal — best for visitors prioritising bars and clubs.
quote: Kreuzberg is easily one of the coolest Berlin neighborhoods, where art meets activism and graffiti becomes gallery-worthy... Grab a Döner kebab, get a can of local beer from a späti

claim: From June 14 to December 12, 2026 the Berlin Stadtbahn is closed to regional and long-distance trains for major switch renewals; S-Bahn lines S3/S5/S7/S75/S9 keep normal frequency except three weekends.
quote: Berlin Stadtbahn between Charlottenburg and Ostbahnhof will be completely closed for regional and long-distance trains from June 14 to December 12, 2026... lines S3, S5, S7, S75, and S9 operate on the Stadtbahn in their usual frequency except for three weekends

claim: Standard German tipping is 5-10% in restaurants, handed verbally to the server with the total amount (not left on the table) and given in cash when paying by card.
quote: 5 to 10 percent of the bill considered appropriate. Rather than leaving money on the table, it's customary to hand your cash or card to your waiter and tell them the total amount

claim: Carry €50-100 cash in Berlin — many cafés, bars, clubs, street food and shops are cash-only; most shops close Sundays except train stations, airports and Spätis.
quote: carry €50-100 minimum. While major hotels, department stores, and larger restaurants accept cards, many small restaurants, cafés, bars, street food vendors, market stalls, and smaller shops are cash only... Most shops are closed Sundays, except train stations and Spätis

claim: Early-June Berlin highlights include the Environment Festival at Brandenburg Gate (June 1), Long Night of the Sciences (June 6-7), Shtetl Berlin (June 9-14), and Hamburger Bahnhof Open House (June 12-14).
quote: On 1 June, the Environment Festival at the Brandenburg Gate... From 6 until 7 June 2026... Long Night of the Sciences... Shtetl Berlin Festival 2026... June 9-14... Open House at the Hamburger Bahnhof from 12 to 14 June
